headline: Rotimi Amaechi Claims Buhari Promised 2022 Presidential Ticket
metaDescription: Rotimi Amaechi alleges a promise of the APC ticket in 2022 as the ADC appeals a court ruling that recently invalidated its leadership and nominations.
aiSummaryBullets: Rotimi Amaechi stated that he was promised the All Progressives Congress presidential ticket in 2022.
The African Democratic Congress has filed an appeal against a Federal High Court judgment that annulled its leadership.
The party requested that the Independent National Electoral Commission refrain from action pending an appellate court review.
aiContextParagraph: Rotimi Amaechi, currently serving as the vice-presidential candidate for the African Democratic Congress (ADC), recently commented on his political history within the All Progressives Congress (APC). He stated that he was promised the presidential ticket during the 2022 primary process. Concurrently, the ADC is navigating legal challenges following a Federal High Court ruling that invalidated the party's leadership structure and its associated candidate nominations, including that of Atiku Abubakar. In response to this judicial development, the campaign representing the affected candidates has submitted both an appeal and an application for a stay of execution. The party has officially urged the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to withhold any administrative enforcement or recognition changes until the Court of Appeal reaches a final decision on the matter. These developments reflect ongoing shifts in Nigerian political party dynamics.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to reports from two independent national outlets concerning political shifts and legal disputes involving major party figures.
